audit.whatIsWrong: Repudiation was described as a 'parry' or 'counter-window', and its grounding was never mentioned at all.

The kit flags it as grounding — that shuts off Spinning Slash, which is Tryndamere's only escape. This is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the page did not contain it.

audit.why: Public Execution is correctly described as lockdown: Riot's text has her blink to the farthest champion in a line, suppress, then slam for damage and a stun. It also grounds. spikes[1].text's answer — spend Undying Rage through it — stands.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 tip to Ambessa once her Q chains, E dashes and W parry let her engage and punish.
edits.after: Level 3 is even; her Q chain, Lacerate's dash and Repudiation only pay off from level 4.

edits.before: Ambessa's power spot: with her W Repudiation counter-window and her Q Cunning Sweep chains plus E dashes she can chain-engage and punish your commits. Don't auto into her W parry, and respect the double-dash gap close when your E is down.
edits.after: Ambessa's power spot: Repudiation shields her and grounds you, so Spinning Slash cannot carry you out, and damage she blocks while bracing amplifies her slam. Don't feed crits into the brace — walk out and re-engage once Lacerate is spent.

edits.before: Levels 2-5 tip toward Ambessa. Her Q Cunning Sweep chains, double E dashes and W Repudiation counter-window let her engage on her terms and punish your commits, and before your R exists her burst can kill you; play the wave and dodge her W parry until you hit 6.
edits.after: Levels 2-5 tip toward Ambessa. Cunning Sweep chains into Sundering Slam, Lacerate dashes her back onto you, and Repudiation braces your crits and grounds your escape, so before your R exists her burst can kill you; hold E until the brace ends.
